messages:
mei: Quick flag from orion-lite q4f16 conversion: we see a small but consistent switch from CJK double quotes (U+201C/U+201D) to ASCII " on zh->en outputs. micro-slice BLEU down ~2.0 on punctuation-heavy subset.

 todd: can you drop a minimal repro?

 mei: repro:
```
input: 我言：「今天的天氣很好。」
fp16: “Today the weather is great.”
q4f16: "Today the weather is great."
```
Spacing around the colon is slightly different too. Breaks our locale-aware detok checks.

 carmen: Did you check token-level probs? tiny score crossovers can cause this.

 mei: Yup. fp16 top-after-quote = U+201C (p=0.41). q4f16 top = U+0022 (p=0.412). Many contexts show 0.003-0.006 prob delta. gist: https://git.internal/r/orion-quote-probs (internal).

 li: Sounds like numeric sensitivity in quant converter (per-group scale rounding). We saw similar with ideographic comma earlier.

 todd: For eval harness: let's add a focused slice name "punct_cjk_quotes" (news/chat/system messages) and compute both pre-detok and post-detok BLEU plus a unicode-swap rate metric.

 mei: Added slice. Quick numbers on the diagnostic set: fp16 pre-detok BLEU=92.1, q4f16 pre-detok=90.0 (delta 2.1). post-detok delta 1.6. unicode-swap_rate=0.65% (48/7400).

 deploy-bot: canary-deploy orion-lite-q4f16 -> started (3 gpus) at 2026-03-21T15:40Z :rocket:

 carmen: Mitigation ideas: 1) converter tweak to preserve higher precision for tokens in a "do-not-round" list (unicode punctuation); 2) short-term: route affected customers to fp16 variant; 3) update gating to fail if slice BLEU drop >1.0 AND swap_rate>0.5%.

 li: I'll prototype the converter tweak (option 1) and run numeric-sensitivity tests. If that doesn't land quickly we can prepare the fp16 pin rollout.

 mei: Action items: mei add slice PR, li run converter tweak test + post probs, todd update gating rules, carmen prepare rollback doc. I'll paste canary numbers here when the job finishes.

 todd: Thanks. Keep it tight ":eyes:"
